title: FxRateResult
description: The 'result' payload shape when ProviderResponseEnvelope.capability='fx_rate' (Manual QA remediation Q.1, §B). One quote: 1 base_currency = rate quote_currency. 'rate' is a decimal STRING, never a JSON number -- a JSON number is IEEE-754 binary float, which this project's own 'Decimal or integer minor units, never binary float' money rule forbids for anything that feeds a currency conversion. Every field needed to disclose full provenance (source, effective date, retrieval timestamp) lives here or on the enclosing envelope (retrieved_at, cache_status) -- a caller must never present a converted amount without being able to also show where the rate came from and when it was true.

rate.description: Decimal string, e.g. '47.935'. Null exactly when the enclosing envelope's status is not 'success' -- never a fabricated/placeholder rate.

effective_date.description: The date this rate was true as of (the provider's own published reference date, e.g. the ECB's latest business-day rate) -- distinct from the envelope's retrieved_at (when THIS call fetched it). Null exactly when rate is null.
